title: How Carely learns and answers
subtitle: Guide files become keyed family memory; a retrieval gate decides whether each text or voice question needs it
description: Flowchart showing Carely guide ingestion, multimodal understanding, Gemini File Search memory, the default-deny retrieval gate, Google Search, text and voice agents, and the final elder-friendly answer.
footer: Family memory is read only during conversations and is skipped for basic or general questions.
